description: This file defines multiple React functional components for form input elements, including TextInput, Select, Checkbox, and CurrencyInput, used in a frontend form interface.

methods.name: TextInput({ label, value, onChange, placeholder, type = 'text', required, min })
methods.description: Renders a labeled text input field with customizable properties such as placeholder, type, and validation.

methods.name: Select({ label, value, onChange, options = [], required })
methods.description: Renders a labeled dropdown select box with provided options, handling selection changes.

methods.name: Checkbox({ label, checked, onChange })
methods.description: Renders a checkbox input with a label, managing checked state.

methods.name: CurrencyInput({ label, value, onChange })
methods.description: Renders a numeric input formatted for currency, with a fixed step for decimal precision.

ctags.name: Select
ctags.pattern: /^export function Select({ label, value, onChange, options = [], required }) {$/

ctags.name: TextInput
ctags.pattern: /^export function TextInput({ label, value, onChange, placeholder, type = 'text', required, min })/
ctags.signature: ({ label, value, onChange, placeholder, type = 'text', required, min })

ctags.name: label
ctags.pattern: /^    <TextInput label={label} type="number" min="0" value={value} onChange={onChange} placeholder/

fields.name: <TextInput label={label} type="number" min="0" value={value} onChange={onChange} placeholder/
